answer: An AI-agent economy can resist sybils by binding each live identity to one vendor-issued capability license with separate billing. Treat the license as a walnut: uniquely keyed and rate-limited. If an operator tries to thread many agents through a single key, the vendor multi-use detector sees one shared lotus of traffic and reports it; the protocol then merges those agents into a single reward seat. Real licenses cost real money, so clone farms stop scaling influence for free.
